title: Week 18 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “civic competency”?
options: The difference between willingness to pay and the price actually paid.
Demonstrated ability to apply civic knowledge and reasoning to institutions, documents, cases, and participation.
A legislature’s grant of authority to an executive agency or official.
The idea that legitimate government rests on an agreement between people and political authority.
questions.explanation: Civic competency means demonstrated ability to apply civic knowledge and reasoning to institutions, documents, cases, and participation.
choices: The difference between willingness to pay and the price actually paid.
